results.description: Another quality eBook from Chapel Library. Articles in this edition of the FGB include: Thinking Like a Christian about Modest Apparel, by Robert G. Spinney. Christian Modesty Defined, by Jeff Pollard. A Crying Sin of Our Age, by A. W. Pink(1886-1952). Symptoms of Bodily Pride, by John Bunyan (1628-1688). Avoiding Immodest Fashions, by Vincent Alsop (1630-1703). Accessories to Adultery, by Robert G. Spinney. Your Clothing Reveals Your Heart, by Richard Baxter (1615-1691). Too Much, Too Little, Too Tight, by Robert G. Spinney. Our Royal Apparel, by Charles H. Spurgeon (1834-1892): God has provided a holy garment through Jesus Christ that fully covers the believer and that satisfies the Father’s demands for righteousness. A Return to Modest Apparel, by Jeff Pollard: an exhortation for the people of God to prayerfully and Biblically embrace Christian modesty.
